title: Disjoint Copy-Loop Registers
statement: For every copy-loop operation $k$, its source register and destination register are distinct, and each is distinct from the scratch register $r_Z$.
replaced:
For arbitrary natural number $E$, four-family Boolean oracle $\mathrm{orc}$, binary word
$x$, and natural-number bound $B$, every copy routine has distinct source and
destination registers, and neither register is the scratch register used by the copy
routine.
